description: The example inputs a review run chooses for Go functions the PR changes, which it writes as examples.json in its run directory beside whooper_examples_test.go, the test that prints what each function returns for each input. As soon as the run ends, whooper-review moves the file to examples.request.json, runs the test once at the head and twice at the merge base, and writes what the test printed as examples.json.

package.description: The folder of the functions' package, from the repository's root, such as services/prices.

functions.description: The functions the test calls, which the PR changes and which write no data.

name.description: As Go code names it, such as Clamp, or Cart.Total for a method.

path.description: Its file, from the repository's root, in the package's folder.

inputs.description: The inputs, in the order a reader should see them.

function.description: The name of one of the functions.

input.description: The input as the test prints it, such as Clamp(101).
